Vistoso Trails
Nature Preserve
Park Rules
Park hours: dawn to dusk
Use of Vistoso Trails Nature Preserve is at your own risk.
Arizona is home to dangerous and poisonous animals, be aware of your
surroundings.
Maintain awareness and treat all trail users with respect and courtesy.
Bicyclists control your speed and be prepared to slow or stop as conditions
dictate.
Stay on the right and pass on the left. Do not cross into oncoming tra ffic.
Pedestrians should watch and listen for cyclists and provide space on the
path for them to pass safely. Don’t suddenly stop or change direction on the
path.
Keep pets leashed and under control at all times.
No motorized vehicles or devices allowed (ADA accessibility and official
vehicles exempt).
Trail conditions subject to change. Verify trail conditions prior to use.
Organized special uses require prior permission.
Do not approach private property adjacent to the trail.
Metal detecting is prohibited.
Park only at designated trail entry locations.
The Vistoso Trails Nature Preserve is designated as a passive recreation site
and subject to all Town of Oro Valley Park rules. For a complete list of park
guidelines please visit
www.orovalleyaz.gov/Government/Departments/Parks-and-Recreation
Questions/comments call Parks and Recreation 520-229-5050
In the event of an emergency, call 911
